title: Warm a movable gas piston
hook: Change absolute temperature and predict ideal-gas volume.
misconception: ideal-gas volume stays fixed when absolute temperature doubles.
objective: Apply V = nRT/P to compare ideal-gas volume when absolute temperature changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed quantity of ideal gas at fixed pressure, V = nRT/P. When absolute temperature doubles, ideal-gas volume becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model V = nRT/P; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed quantity of ideal gas at fixed pressure, with a nonzero initial result. If absolute temperature triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on ideal-gas volume?
recall.why: Apply V = nRT/P under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
